name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: Unique identifier of the sys_email_draft record to fetch. Use -1 to create a new record.

name: targetTable
label: Target table
description: Name of target table for this record

name: targetRecord
label: Target record
description: Unique identifier of the associated record

name: fitToParent
label: Fit to parent
description: Select to match the email client's height with the parent

name: autoresize
label: Autoresize
description: Let the inputs grow and shrink its height with the text you enter

name: showSendButtonAsIcon
label: Show send button as icon
description: Select to show 'send email' button as icon or button.

name: sendEmailButtonSize
label: 'Send email' button size
description: Select size of 'Send email' button

name: replyType
label: Response type
description: Select the type of response action

name: replyId
label: Email record ID
description: Unique identifier of the sys_email record to respond to

name: createDraftOnLoad
label: Create draft on load
description: Enable this to create a draft record on load

name: showEmailDetails
label: Show email details
description: Select to show the To, CC, BCC, Reply to & From fields

name: disableToCcBcc
label: Disable recipient fields
description: Permanently disable To, CC, and/or BCC fields. Use true to disable all, false for none, or an object like {"cc": true, "bcc": true} for specific fields.

name: showCcBcc
label: Show CC and BCC fields
description: Select to show CC and BCC fields initially. Use with disableToCcBcc when To field is disabled.

name: templateDetails
label: Template details
description: Details of the template to be applied

name: insertLinkInEmail
label: Link details
description: Link details to add in the email. Inserts the message in the last active cursor position.

name: hideSend
label: Hide Send Button
description: Select to hide the 'Send email' button

name: loadLatestDraft
label: Load latest draft
description: Select to use the latest saved draft/sys_email_draft record

name: initiateSendEmail
label: Initiate send email
description: Select to trigger the send action

name: emailValidationStatus
label: Can prevalidate and send email
description: Object with { value: true/false, ts: timestamp } to confirm or cancel email send after prevalidation

name: showPopOut
label: Allow pop out
description: Select to show the email pop-out button

name: forceHorizontalLayout
label: Enable horizontal layout
description: Select to display the labels horizontally

name: sendEmailButtonVariant
label: 'Send email' button variant
description: Select variant of the 'Send email' button

name: showCreateNewEmail
label: Allow email creation
description: Select to show the 'Create new email' button

name: showDiscardDraft
label: Allow discarding
description: Select to show the 'Discard draft' button

name: showViewDrafts
label: Allow managing drafts
description: Select to show the 'Manage drafts' button

name: showAttachments
label: Allow attachments
description: Select to show the 'Attach files' button

name: showRecentDrafts
label: Show recent drafts
description: Select to show the 'Recent drafts' button

name: showEmailTemplates
label: Show email templates
description: Select to show/hide 'Email templates'

name: showQuickMessages
label: Show quick messages
description: Select to show/hide 'Quick messages'

name: enableMentioningUsers
label: Enable mentioning users
description: Enable mentioning users in the compose area

name: showResponseTemplates
label: Show response templates
description: Select to show/hide 'Response templates

name: extraParams
label: Extra params
description: Pass URL extra-params values to email client to decode

name: popoutIcon
label: Popout icon
description: Select the icon for the popout button

name: prePopulatedTo
label: Pre-populated To recipients
description: Array of email addresses (strings) or recipient objects to pre-populate the To field. These will be merged with any existing recipients from templates or drafts. Duplicates are automatically filtered.

name: prePopulatedCc
label: Pre-populated CC recipients
description: Array of email addresses (strings) or recipient objects to pre-populate the CC field. These will be merged with any existing recipients from templates or drafts. Duplicates are automatically filtered.

name: prePopulatedBcc
label: Pre-populated BCC recipients
description: Array of email addresses (strings) or recipient objects to pre-populate the BCC field. These will be merged with any existing recipients from templates or drafts. Duplicates are automatically filtered.

name: suppressGlobalEvents
label: Suppress global events
description: Suppress events that rely on parent elements handling, and only dispatch events with the component prefix that are manually binded
